title: spec_reopened event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. Records a governed closed-to-active transition (caws specs reopen), the inverse of spec_closed. Reopen is distinct from spec_restored (archived->draft/active via body recovery) and spec_activated (draft->active): it operates on an existing closed canonical body, removes the terminal fields (resolution/closure_notes/superseded_by) so the active spec passes validate-semantics, and leaves the spec unbound (close already cleared the worktree field). Carries previous_lifecycle_state for audit-trail parity with spec_activated.

previous_lifecycle_state.description: The lifecycle state the spec held before reopen (always closed; other states are refused by reopenSpec).

reason.description: Optional operator-supplied reason for reopening (e.g. 'work determined incomplete after merge'). Recorded on the event, NOT as closure_notes (that field is removed by reopen).
